name: Old Hickory Steakhouse
notes: 3 photos of printed menu pages. Photo 1 is page 1 (Chilled Seafood & Crudo, Starters, Salads and Soup). Photos 2 and 3 are two versions of page 2 (Land and Sea / Prime Hand-Cut); photo 3, the newer-looking branded card, was used as canonical (King Ora Salmon, 32oz Tomahawk $235, 22oz Cowboy Ribeye $110, Loaded Fingerlings $18). Photo 2 showed an older/different version (Lemon Pepper Halibut instead of the salmon dish, Tomahawk $225, Cowboy Ribeye $98, Duck Fat Fingerlings $16) and was not merged in, to avoid mixing two conflicting price/menu eras. Sauce add-ons under Accompaniments were excluded as modifiers, and the add-on caviar upgrade to the Seafood Tower was excluded as a modifier.
